newsitem.title: USA: PMI Group Inc Q1 net income rises.
newsitem.headline: PMI Group Inc Q1 net income rises.

text.p: NOTE: Excluding capital gains, operating earnings per share were $1.09 for the first quarter compared to $0.94 for the first quarter of 1996, a 16 percent increase.

Q1 total revenue growth was led by net premiums earned of $108.1 million, an increase of 16 percent over the prior year period, and net investment income of $20.0 million, which increased 27 percent over the prior year period.

Realized capital gains, due primarily to investment portfolio restructuring, were $18.3 million for the first quarter, an increase of 195 percent over the prior year period, and other revenue was $1.2 million, up 33 percent.

For the mortgage insurance operations, net premiums earned for the first quarter were $95.7 million, compared to $81.1 million for the first quarter of 1996, loss expenses were $39.2 million for the first quarter, compared to $33.3 million a year ago, and underwriting expenses were $20.0 million for the first quarter, compared to $17.1 million a year ago.

The 1996 first quarter results included the cession of $4.7 million in net premiums earned, loss expenses of $2.8 million and underwriting expenses of $1.6 million in connection with a reinsurance treaty with Centre Re.
